data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock8 and low-recovery stock16. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation.
